READABILITY.evidence: The API types in consistent_hash_types.go have clear names (ConsistentHashHeader, ConsistentHashRegexRewrite) and full doc comments, including dedup and ordering notes. Formatting follows existing kubebuilder conventions.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: Types sit in their own file and the plugin logic (IR, Equals/Validate, constructor, merge, apply) is grouped in consistent_hash.go. Merge is registered in merge.go and apply in the plugin, following the existing pattern. Generated code came from make go-generate-apis.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: Inputs are checked at the API boundary: MinLength/MaxLength, MaxItems, a CEL ttl regex (a MaxLength=32 limit fixed the CEL cost problem) and CEL disable exclusivity. The IR has a Validate step. CRD negative tests were added.

C7-11-CASE1.evidence: A dedicated merge is registered in MergeTrafficPolicies. It unions array fields with higher-priority entries first, dedupes, outputs canonical order and keeps the higher-priority sourceIp. Metadata is recorded as consistentHash. Golden test and hidden tests pass.

C7-11-CASE2.evidence: {} defaults to one sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false, and disable produces no policies. The generated CRD has a CEL rule 'no other fields may be set when disable is true', covered by the invalid-disable-with-headers and invalid-disable-with-source-ip tests.
